All five declare capabilityProvider:false so the Web/Android capability list is unchanged, and each DONOR.json carries the mission block and agrees with the manifest. The gate 'at least one real product consumption, reusing an existing Utopia consumption surface' is UNMET, recorded rather than claimed. The five modules form a research pipeline whose only existing Utopia consumer is the research.evidence.review capability, bound to evidence-engine - a different migrated module that MB-007 forbids re-implementing and whose verdicts the Verification gate requires to keep passing unchanged. Wiring any module into that path would either alter the Evidence Engine's verdicts or add an operation to the Web+Android capability list, a new product surface also forbidden by MB-007's no-new-paper-workflow rule. The only equivalence-preserving rewiring found is the mean in scripts/resource-pilot.mjs, a host measurement script that is not one of the surfaces rule 14 names, and a one-function decoration is not a consumption. Seven modules in MB-001/003/006 each got an exact mechanism rewiring; here none is available, so the Owner must rule.

Not established: the donor PDF compile step is deferred so no compiled artifact exists, the five modules' PARITY vectors were not re-derived against the donor here, and this does not make the pipeline a complete product runtime.

Verifier finding: the v2 rules and the episode finalizer disagree. finalize-mission-episode.mjs requires a PASS MIGRATION_COMPLETE event from the migration host, but MB-007 is the case README section 7.2 was written for: its migration host recorded RUNTIME_FAIL/BLOCKED for the product-consumption gate and never wrote MIGRATION_COMPLETE, while the Owner overrode that gate in response-9-29 R6 and declared the migration complete. The finalizer refuses this Mission with 'Missing PASS MIGRATION_COMPLETE' even though the ruling, the mission front matter and the green gates all agree verification passed. This verifier did not backfill that event: doing so would attribute to the migration host a claim it never made and overwrite its recorded blocker. Consequence: current tooling cannot generate a verified episode for MB-007, so the merge decision rests on R6 directly.
